metaTitle: LessonCraftStudio for Schools: Quotes and Invoices for K-3 Teams
metaDescription: Lesson plans, worksheets, and sub plans for kindergarten through grade 3, matched to Common Core and the Texas TEKS. Request a quote and one invoice for your teachers.
title: LessonCraftStudio for Your School
lead: Lesson plans, worksheets, and sub plans for kindergarten through grade 3. The lessons are matched to the Common Core standards and the Texas TEKS. Tell us how many teachers need the {plan} plan, and we will send you a quote and one invoice for the school.
planTitle: What each teacher gets with the {plan} plan
planLead: The {plan} plan is one account per teacher. Each teacher you order the plan for gets:
planItemUnits: The whole-unit PDF, the teacher guide, and the printable scope and sequence for every unit
planItemSubs: The guest teacher pages for every sub plan, ready to leave on the desk
planOne: Buying for one teacher? You can subscribe by card on the pricing page.
seeTitle: See what is covered before you buy
seeLead: Everything below is open to read without an account, so you can check it against your own curriculum map first.
seeChecklistsNote: One grade and one subject per page, listed by official code. Each checklist prints as a coverage document: every code, what we have for it, and what is not covered.
seeUnitsNote: Each unit is a sequence of lessons with a teacher note, the worksheets, and practice on screen.
seeSubsNote: Review days for a guest teacher, by grade and time of year.
howTitle: How buying for a school works
howStep1: Send the form below with the number of teachers.
howStep3: If you go ahead, you send us the email addresses of the teachers, and we send one invoice to the school.
howStep4: When the invoice is paid, we turn on the {plan} plan for each of those email addresses.
studentsText: Children do not need an account or an email address for anything on the site. A teacher shares a link or prints the page.
formLead: We usually answer within two business days.
formPrivacy: We use what you write here only to answer your request.
sent: Thank you. Your request is with us, and we will answer by email.
failed: That did not go through. Please try again, or write to {email}.
tooMany: You have sent several requests in a short time. Please try again in an hour, or write to {email}.
invalid: Please fill in your name, your school, a valid email address, and the number of teachers.
pricingLink: Buying for several teachers? Request a quote for your school
checklistLink: Buying for a school? Request a quote and one invoice
